infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Allow Elsewhere to read your calendar to find better trip windows around birthdays, holidays, and free weekends.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Allow Elsewhere to read your calendar to find better trip windows around birthdays, holidays, and free weekends.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Allow Elsewhere to consider reminders only when you choose to connect them for trip planning.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Elsewhere to find trip photos and videos by date and location so you can approve them for the trip feed and recap.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Elsewhere to save trip recap exports and story-ready media to your library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Elsewhere to show nearby trips, local events, and weekend ideas in Discover.
